storage_box_not_found.title: Storage box {storage_box_id} not found
storage_box_not_found.description:
The Hetzner API reports storage box {storage_box_id} as not found — deleted, or not accessible with this API token. Home Assistant keeps retrying and removes this message once the box can be read again.

If the storage box was deleted, delete this integration entry. If it belongs to another project than the API token, select Reconfigure in the menu of this integration entry and enter an API token of that project.
